Three layers, three different questions

Each tool catches problems the others miss

Does the app work for a user?

Katalon Studio

End-to-end UI automation. It opens the real app, clicks and types like a driver would, and verifies what is on the screen. It catches integration bugs, broken screens and wrong messages.

WebUI.setText(input_battery, '20')
WebUI.click(btn_confirm)
WebUI.verifyElementText(txt_priority,
  'HIGH PRIORITY')
Is each rule correct?

JUnit 5

Fast unit tests for the Kotlin business rules: priority, tariff, validation, cost and booking guards. They run in milliseconds on every commit, and JaCoCo measures which lines they cover.

@Test fun `priority is HIGH at 20%`() {
  assertEquals("HIGH",
    rules.priorityFor(20))
}
Are the tests good enough?

PIT mutation testing

Plants small bugs (mutants) in the code and re-runs the tests. If no test fails, the suite has a blind spot. In ChargeFlow this exposed the missing tests at the 20%, 0%, 100%, 15-minute and 120-minute boundaries.

battery <= 20  →  battery < 20
tests at 19 and 21 still pass
→ SURVIVED · add a test at 20
